pluginText.pf.safety: {"words":["a power line down in the yard","someone swallowed or splashed a lawn chemical","a gas smell","a wasp or hornet nest in the yard","a tree or a big limb down on the house"],"what_happens":["A power line down: stay well away, keep children and pets inside, treat it as live. Call 911, then the power company. No crew is booked until the utility says it's safe.","A chemical swallowed or splashed: call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if the person isn't breathing or can't wake up. Keep the product label at hand.","A gas smell: leave and call 911. No booking until it's safe.","A wasp or hornet nest: the crew leaves that area out. Pest control can come first.","A tree or limb on the house: call 911 if anyone is hurt; a tree service comes first, then the lawn work."],"booking_goes_on":"No, for a power line down, a poisoning or a gas smell. Yes, with the area left out, for a nest or a fallen limb in the yard."}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"neighbor_notice":"Before a spray, where the state's rules require it, the applicator gives written notice to the neighbors (door notices, or people on the state's registry within its distance), naming the date and a backup day. Rosie never texts the neighbors. Spray times start after the notice's lead time (the example: 2 days). Sam gets a to-do and replies when it's done.","customer_notice":"Where the state's rules require it, the customer gets the written spray notice before the first spray: the products, the dates and the safety steps.","local_limits":"Where a town bans or limits weed sprays on home lawns, the address is checked before the customer's yes, and fertilizer only is offered at its own price.","aeration_prep":"Flag sprinkler heads and any buried dog-fence wire before aeration. The crew skips flagged spots.","first_cut":"A lawn not mowed in 3 weeks gets the first cut and cleanup before a weekly plan starts.","prep_for_reminder":["Keep pets inside, or where you said","Pick up toys, hoses and dog waste","Leave the gate unlocked, or the code on the secure page","Before a spray: close nearby windows, and keep children and pets off the lawn"]}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"Someone home (the first cut's walk-around, a visit priced on site): the code at the door, entered by the crew lead. Nobody home (plan mows, sprays, aeration, plowing): no code; DONE with a photo of the lawn and the latched gate.","gate_and_dog":"The crew checks the gate and the dog before mowing. A loose dog: the customer is asked to bring it in within 15 minutes, and only what's safe is mowed. The gate is latched at the end, every time.","weather":"Rain: the crew lead moves the whole route to the next dry day with one text, and every customer on it is told. A move for weather is free. Sprays: the applicator checks wind and rain against the product label; too windy means fertilizer today and the spray on the notice's backup day, at one price.","after_spray":"Marker flags at the edges of the treated lawn where the state's rules require them. The keep-off time and the products used are texted to the customer.","drop_off":"At Lee Mower Shop: the code is given at the counter when the mower is left. Status words IN and READY; READY comes with a photo. Pick-up only by the customer or someone they name.","changes_at_visit":"Brush clearing is priced before any work. Extra work (beds, a hedge, a leaf haul-away) only when the customer asks, priced first. A right to cancel where the state's rules give one.","proof_done":"Before and after photos, and a photo of the latched gate. A spray adds the application record the state's rules require.","redo":"Something missed: tell the business within 24 hours; the crew comes back free, usually the next day."}
pluginText.pf.money: {"start":"Lawn care: the plug-in starts every service with a card saved at booking for the trip fee, each visit charged at its own DONE. Sam can pick one bill a month for a plan instead, or the full price when booking, as many lawn businesses sell seasonal jobs prepaid (the example: core aeration). Lee Mower Shop: nothing taken and no card saved, so no fee; paid at the counter at pick-up. A blade sharpening at home takes nothing either: Rosie texts the bill after.","deposits":"None for upkeep. Sam can set one per service, within the state's caps. Deposit cap: from the state form.","fees":"Late cancel, a locked gate or a loose dog: the business's own trip fee (the example: $89 on a one-time visit, $25 on a plan mow or a spray), never more than the visit's price. The owner confirms each one; no answer, no fee.","plans":"Each cut is charged at its own DONE. Nothing is charged while the plan is paused for winter. Rosfield's $2 counts once a month for a plan.","tips":"Optional, all to the crew. A tip line only if the owner turns it on.","tax":"A sales tax line only where the state taxes lawn care, from the state form.","rosfield_fee":"The usual $2 per confirmed booking."}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_texts":["Gate codes and lock combinations","Health reasons for staying away from a product","Neighbors' names or numbers: Rosie never texts the neighbors"],"photos":"Photos of the yard go only to the customer and the business.","languages":"English and Spanish. Neighbor notices are printed by the business, in the languages the state's rules ask for.","minors":"Nobody under 18 books. A teen at home isn't the booking's adult."}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"skills":["Mowing and cleanups","Sprays and lawn renovation (certified applicator only)","Aeration","Snow plowing","Mower repair at the shop: sharpening, tune-ups, carburetor work"],"crews":"Two per mowing or cleanup crew: a lead, who sees the gate code and texts DONE, and a helper.","licenses":"Each person who sprays holds the state's applicator certification. Where the state allows a registered technician to spray under a certified applicator, the supervision rule comes from its form. Mowing crews and mechanics need none.","new_person_ok":"Plan mows: any crew with the route may come, since nobody needs to be home. A spray or a renovation: only a certified applicator, never anyone else.","who_oks":"The owner OKs new mowing customers' prices (he checks the lot) and quotes over the limit. The office manager may too; the owner's answer wins."}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"pesticide_notices":["Neighbor notices before a spray: yes or no, the lead time, the distance and the languages, from the state form.","A written spray notice to the customer before the first spray, where the state's rules require it.","Marker flags after a spray: yes or no, and how long they stay up, from the state form.","A moved spray needs a new notice unless the new day is the backup day on the old one."],"local_bans":"Towns or counties that ban or limit lawn sprays on home lawns: the address is checked before the yes, and the allowed service is offered instead.","records":"The spray record each state requires (product, its EPA number, the area, the applicator, the weather), kept for the state's time, and 7 years like every booking.","plans":["The plan's terms show before any card: how often, the price a cut, when it's charged, the season, and how to end it.","The plan gets its own yes, apart from the booking, and the terms are texted back.","At the season's end the plan pauses with one text; nothing is charged while it's paused.","Before it starts again, a text with the date and the price, and how to end it.","A price change is told 30 days ahead, or more where the state's rules ask. One reply ends the plan."],"add_on_at_home":"A right to cancel where the state's rules give one for work sold at the home.","written_contract":"Above an amount, where the state's rules require it (a lawn renovation).","landlord":"A renter's spray or renovation may need the owner's OK."}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"matter_most":["Rain on a route day: one text from the crew lead moves the whole route to the next dry day; no fee.","Wind on a spray day: fertilizer today, the spray on the notice's backup day, at one price.","A loose dog or a locked gate: a 15-minute wait, only what's safe is mowed, and the owner decides any fee.","Something missed: a free return visit, never money from Rosie.","A crew lead out: the route moves a day, or Sam runs it. A spray waits for a certified applicator.","The season ends: the plan pauses, and a text comes before it starts again.","A town that bans weed sprays: fertilizer only, before the yes.","A sprinkler head or dog-fence wire hit while aerating: photos the same day; the owner decides.","Several open bookings (plan mows and a spray): which one is asked first.","A mower not picked up at the shop: reminders; a storage fee only if the owner starts it, after written notice."],"rest":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way."}
